title: NigerDelta HSSE Tracker

creators.name: Owhonda, Gideon
creators.affiliation: NLNG Centre for Gas, Refining and Petrochemical Engineering, University of Port Harcourt

description: A free, offline-capable Progressive Web Application enabling Niger Delta residents to report oil spills, gas flares, and environmental health incidents, and to track regulatory response and estimated methane emissions. Device-local architecture: reports are stored on the reporting device only, with no server and no automatic sync. Reaching NOSDRA, a journalist, or anyone else is always an explicit action by the reporter — generating a notification letter, exporting a signed JSON record, or sharing a reference number.
